label: D1 reward shown after reaching S2 (strongest after rare a1->S2 reward), fades late in episode
explanation: Fires only at D1, only when the reward input is 1, and (dev) only when the previous trial reached S2 (prev_state==2, or unknown at the window start). The predicate D1 & rewarded & prev_state!=1 has recall 1.0 but precision 0.44. Adding ep_trial<70 raises dev F1 from 0.61 to 0.71 (mass recall 0.90), because the rate falls steadily over the episode (about 0.10 in trials 0-39, near 0 in trials 90-99). Magnitude: the largest activations come after a rare a1->S2 rewarded trial (prev_action==1 & prev_state==2: precision 0.90, 54% of activation mass on 16% of active steps), i.e. reward from S2 when the agent chose a1, especially when S1 is the good state. After common a2->S2 rewards the feature is weaker and decays over a run of consecutive S2 rewards (e.g. 0.21 -> 0.10 -> 0.05 -> 0.03), which accounts for most false positives. Never fires at GO or D2, on unrewarded D1, or after S1 rewards. Uses only observed variables (prev reward, prev state, prev action) plus episode time.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: last=a1 S2 r (+5.10), phase=D1 & last=a1 S2 r (+5.00), in_rew=1 (+4.53), phase=D1 & value_bin=decile 8 (9 = highest) (+4.10), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 5 (9 = most a1) (+3.33), phase=D1 & value_bin=decile 7 (9 = highest) (+3.24). Lower it: prev_state=1 (-10.70), in_rew=0 (-8.66), stay=0 (-6.63), action=1 (-5.72).
